title: Studio Loft Office
summary: An industrial loft turned into a flexible studio for a creative agency, balancing open collaboration and quiet focus.
story: Interviews with the team shaped a plan of zones rather than rooms: a busy front of house, a central project table and quiet booths along the back wall.
Acoustic felt, timber slats and planting soften the concrete shell without hiding its character.
Furniture on castors means the main floor can turn into an event space in under an hour.
coverAlt: Dark oak kitchen with a long island and two paper pendants
